title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 1.33 (quiet) at 19:00 UTC on 6 October 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 10 月 6 日 19:00 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 1.33（平靜）。

summary.en: Latest reliable hour-start estimated Kp is 1.33 (1P) at 19:00 UTC on 6 October 2026. The 19 hour is complete (60 samples through 19:59; hour-start 1.33/1P, hour-end 1.33/1P). Last-180 maximum is 2.67 (first at 2026-10-06T20:57:00Z; label 3M). Published-window maximum is 2.67 (first at 2026-10-06T20:57:00Z; label 3M). Window starts 2026-10-06T15:00:00Z (358 samples). Window estimated_kp reached 2.67. The 20 UTC hour is incomplete (58 samples through 20:57).

evidence.limitations: Values are estimated Kp at 1-minute cadence and can be revised. The card uses the latest hour that has a full 60 samples; the following hour may still be incomplete.
evidence.method: NOAA SWPC planetary_k_index_1m.json. Main card is the hour-start estimated_kp of the latest complete hour. last-180 and published-window maxima are the first occurrence of the maximum estimated_kp in each window.
